selection_rationale: Indices 3 and 7 are the only surveys explicitly published within the 2023‑2025 window and directly address monocular depth estimation. Paper 3 ('Survey on Monocular Metric Depth Estimation', Jan 2025) focuses on metric depth, a key recent concern. Paper 7 ('Deep Learning-based Depth Estimation Methods from Monocular Image and Videos: A Comprehensive Survey', Jun 2024) provides a broad, up‑to‑date overview of deep‑learning approaches, matching the requested scope. The other candidates are either older (pre‑2023), pertain to different modalities (e.g., endoscopic, binocular stereo), or are not surveys of monocular depth estimation.
